'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Winston Plunkett LS Tatooine: Slave Quarters''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Winston Plunkett]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Slave Quarters|Tat-L-tatooineslavequarters.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' SHMI'S HUT
* '''Username:''' WinstonP
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
